channel_semantics.adv_tau_hat: D29-R1 directional ADV travel time sampled at each Pollock node by containing cell, divided by pollock_tau_end_s
channel_semantics.log10_Kh: log10(sqrt(Kx*Ky)) sampled at each Pollock node
channel_semantics.log10_Kz_over_Kh: log10(Kz/sqrt(Kx*Ky)) sampled at each Pollock node
channel_semantics.porosity: D23 Recipe1.1 porosity sampled at each Pollock node
channel_semantics.pressure_z: D25 pressure_psi sampled raw, then z-scored using TRAIN-only global channel statistics

sampling_contract.rule: containing Cartesian cell at exact frozen Pollock XYZ; no interpolation
sampling_contract.boundary_policy: floor coordinate/cell-size then clip to valid final cell index; outside-domain tolerance 1e-8 m

control_encoding.rule: rate/BHP act through the already-frozen physical case state: pressure, Pollock/ADV travel times, and eta; no new Stage-4 control law or direct channel is invented

prohibited: Y target use for predictor statistics
direct rate/BHP channel insertion without a new prospective contract
